te: Water, irrigation and a model for raising farmers' income in Pak Phanang considered
se: The meeting considered water management and irrigation in the Pak Phanang river basin, covering 13 districts, together with land use information from the Land Development Department, and considered a model for raising agricultural income based on this area as a case study
it: Water management and irrigation in the Pak Phanang river basin
A model for raising agricultural income

te: Strengths, weaknesses and models from the Pak Phanang study visit analysed
se: The meeting continued its consideration of the summary of the study visits to Nakhon Si Thammarat and Phatthalung, setting out strengths, weaknesses and models for agricultural development, and considered the results of a sample survey on the liquidity of small farmers in the Pak Phanang river basin
it: Strengths, weaknesses and models for agricultural development from the study visits
Results of the survey on the liquidity of small farmers in the Pak Phanang river basin

te: Summary of the Nakhon Si Thammarat and Phatthalung study visits
se: The meeting summarised the study visit to Nakhon Si Thammarat and Phatthalung Provinces on 2–4 April 2025, made to study approaches to debt management in the Pak Phanang river basin, an area of rice fields, forests, hills and sea. It heard about whole-system water management, livelihood development and royally initiated projects in the area
it: Summary of the study visit to Nakhon Si Thammarat and Phatthalung Provinces, 2–4 April 2025

te: Briefing by the Royal Irrigation Department on water management in the Pak Phanang river basin
se: The meeting studied water management, its obstacles and solutions, and invited the Director of Regional Irrigation Office 15 and the Director of the Pak Phanang River Basin Development Coordination Centre (royally initiated) to give information on the general conditions of the area, water management and water volumes
it: Water management in the Pak Phanang river basin

te: Briefing by 13 district chiefs on farm households in the Pak Phanang river basin
se: The meeting studied basic farm household data in the Pak Phanang river basin, covering 13 districts, and invited the district chiefs of 10 districts in Nakhon Si Thammarat Province, 2 districts in Phatthalung Province, and Ranot District, Songkhla Province, to give information
it: Basic farm household data in the Pak Phanang river basin

te: Briefing by the Cooperative Promotion Department, the Cooperative Auditing Department and the debtor assistance centre
se: The meeting noted the order appointing a subcommittee member to fill a vacancy, and studied the overall picture of farmers' debt, its obstacles and solutions. It invited representatives of the Cooperative Promotion Department, the Cooperative Auditing Department and the Centre for Assistance to Debtors and People Treated Unfairly to give information
it: Order appointing a subcommittee member to fill a vacancy
Overall picture of farmers' debt, obstacles and solutions

te: Agencies heard on farmers' informal debt
se: The meeting noted the order appointing additional subcommittee members and advisers, and studied the overall picture of informal debt and the related work done. It invited representatives of the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Agriculture and Cooperatives, the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Interior and the National Village and Urban Community Fund Office to give information
it: Order appointing additional subcommittee members and advisers
Overall picture of informal debt and work done

te: Briefing by the Bank of Thailand, the BAAC and the Department of Provincial Administration on the structure of farmers' debt
se: The meeting studied the overall structure of farm household debt and invited representatives of the Bank of Thailand, the Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives and the Department of Provincial Administration to give information. The Bank of Thailand representative explained that farmers' debt is widespread, averaging about 450,000 baht per household, and that more than 41 per cent has been under debt moratorium measures for more than 4 years
it: Structure of farm household debt and approaches to managing it

te: Work begins: appointment order noted, and a framework for the farmer debt study set
se: The meeting noted the order appointing the subcommittee, whose duty is to study information, facts, laws and measures on the debts of Thai farmers in order to propose ways to prevent and solve the problem to the government. It considered its framework, set a working period of 120 days, and will invite the agencies concerned to give information
it: Framework and 120-day timeframe for the work

te: Pushing forward the project to take fishing boats out of the system
se: The meeting considered how to push forward the project to take fishing boats out of the system. The Department of Fisheries explained that the National Fisheries Policy Committee has approved a project to take 923 boats out of service to manage marine fisheries resources sustainably, and that it is seeking agencies' views before proposing it to the Council of Ministers. The subcommittee proposed that it be put to the Council of Ministers quickly; that future rounds use the Department of Fisheries' annual budget; that boats taken out of service be put to other uses, such as artificial reefs or passenger boats; and that the information be publicised to fishers
it: Approaches to pushing forward the project to take fishing boats out of the system

te: Study of the draft amendment to the Fisheries Royal Ordinance
se: Agenda: study of the draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. ...., under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure (the Senate has not yet published the summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda in the meeting notice, not a resolution of the meeting)
it: Draft Act amending the Fisheries Royal Ordinance B.E. 2558 (2015), B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119)

te: Meeting 1/2568 · Subcommittee on Fisheries to Study the Royal Ordinance on Fisheries B.E. 2558
Briefing by the alternative agriculture network on food security
se: The meeting heard representatives of the Alternative Agriculture Network and a chemical-free farming network on developing farming systems, food safety and the state of Thailand's food security in various dimensions, such as access to food resources, which is still limited by law
it: The food security situation and alternative farming systems

te: Meeting 8/2568 · Subcommittee to Study Food Security
Briefing by the FDA and the Department of Agriculture on testing fruit and vegetables for chemicals
se: The meeting studied the control, testing and prevention of food products, vegetables and fruit that may be contaminated with chemicals, as well as the oversight of the production, sale, registration, import and export of agricultural hazardous substances. It invited the Food and Drug Administration and the Department of Agriculture to give information
it: Control and testing of chemical residues in food, vegetables and fruit

te: Schedule set for food security study visits to Sa Kaeo and Chachoengsao
se: The meeting considered the draft schedule of study visits on food security and food safety in Sa Kaeo and Chachoengsao Provinces in December 2025, such as a briefing at Wang Nam Yen Town Municipality, Sa Kaeo Province
it: Schedule of the study visits to Sa Kaeo and Chachoengsao Provinces
